example_1_en: The designer must incorporate mechanical and thermal requirements.
example_1_zh: 設計師必須納入機械與熱要求。
example_2_en: The panel design should incorporate dedicated bonding points.
example_2_zh: 板件設計應納入專用 搭接 點。

example_1_en: An electrical bond is a conductive connection between two items.
example_1_zh: 電氣接合是兩個物件之間的導電連接。
example_2_en: A reliable electrical bond is necessary for current return and protection.
example_2_zh: 可靠的電氣接合對電流回路與防護很重要。

example_1_en: A bond classification is based on the purpose of the electrical bond.
example_1_zh: 接合分類是依電氣接合的用途決定。
example_2_en: Each bond classification is associated with different electrical characteristics.
example_2_zh: 每種接合分類都對應不同的電氣特性。

example_1_en: Each bond class has different characteristics.
example_1_zh: 每一種搭接類別 都有不同特性。
example_2_en: Material characteristics affect bonding performance.
example_2_zh: 材料特性會影響 搭接 性能。

example_1_en: A floating chassis can become a shock hazard.
example_1_zh: 浮接 機殼 可能變成電擊危害。
example_2_en: Class H bonding reduces the shock hazard during a fault.
example_2_zh: H 類搭接 可降低故障時的電擊危害。

example_1_en: A dedicated current return path is preferred for power circuits.
example_1_zh: 電源電路最好使用專用的電流回流路徑。
example_2_en: Do not rely on the composite panel as the current return path.
example_2_zh: 不要依賴複材板作為電流回流路徑。

example_1_en: Use a dedicated power return instead of relying on structure.
example_1_zh: 使用專用電源回流，而不是依賴結構。
example_2_en: A dedicated bonding pad simplifies inspection.
example_2_zh: 專用 搭接墊 可簡化檢查。

example_1_en: Coordination with the power distribution designer may be required.
example_1_zh: 可能需要與電源分配設計工程師協調。
example_2_en: Good coordination between EMC and structural teams reduces rework.
example_2_zh: EMC 與結構團隊良好協調可減少重工。

example_1_en: Large systems, especially those with EMI concerns, need a dedicated return.
example_1_zh: 大型系統，尤其是有 EMI 疑慮者，需要專用回流。
example_2_en: This is especially important near fuel systems.
example_2_zh: 這在燃料系統附近尤其重要。

example_1_en: The voltage drop must be controlled in the power return path.
example_1_zh: 電源回流路徑中的壓降必須受到控制。
example_2_en: Excessive voltage drop may reduce equipment margin.
example_2_zh: 過大的壓降可能降低設備裕度。

example_1_en: Do not rely on the vehicle structure as the primary power return.
example_1_zh: 不要依賴載具結構作為主要電源回流路徑。
example_2_en: Bonding jumpers should not rely on adjacent parts for their connection.
example_2_zh: 搭接跨接線 不應依賴相鄰零件形成連接。

example_1_zh: 若產生火花，燃料蒸氣可能被點燃。
example_2_en: Joints near vapors require special attention.
example_2_zh: 靠近蒸氣的接合處需要特別注意。

example_1_zh: 直流接合電阻是在電氣接點兩端量測。
example_2_en: The allowed DC bond resistance is different for each bond class.
example_2_zh: 各接合分類允許的直流接合電阻不同。

example_1_en: A power return bond is used to carry intentional current through structure.
example_1_zh: 電源回流接合用於讓預定電流經結構回流。
example_2_en: A power return bond is sized for current and voltage-drop limits.
example_2_zh: 電源回流接合會依電流與壓降限制決定尺寸。

example_1_en: Proper bonding helps achieve the shielding objective.
example_1_zh: 適當的 搭接 有助於達成 屏蔽 目標。
example_2_en: To achieve low resistance, remove nonconductive coatings from the faying surface.
example_2_zh: 為達成低電阻，需移除接合面的非導電塗層。

example_1_en: The intent of a Class H bond is to prevent shock hazards.
example_1_zh: H 類搭接 的目的在於防止電擊危害。
example_2_en: Understand the intent of the requirement before selecting a method.
example_2_zh: 選擇方法前，要先理解要求的目的。

example_1_en: The structure must carry fault current until the protection device opens.
example_1_zh: 結構必須承載故障電流，直到保護裝置動作斷開。
example_2_en: A small contact area may overheat under fault current.
example_2_zh: 接觸面積太小可能在故障電流下過熱。

example_1_en: A shock-hazard bond is used to protect personnel from exposed voltage.
example_1_zh: 觸電危害防護接合用於保護人員免受外露電壓危害。
example_2_en: A shock-hazard bond is required to carry fault current safely.
example_2_zh: 觸電危害防護接合必須能安全承載故障電流。

example_1_en: The chassis should be connected to the reference plane.
example_1_zh: 機殼應連接到參考平面。
example_2_en: A powered chassis must have a safe fault-current path.
example_2_zh: 有供電的機殼必須具有安全的故障電流路徑。

example_1_en: An accidental fault may place primary power on the equipment enclosure.
example_1_zh: 意外故障可能使設備外殼帶有主電源電壓。
example_2_en: Proper bonding provides a safe path for accidental current.
example_2_zh: 適當的 搭接 可為意外電流提供安全路徑。

example_1_en: RF impedance is more important than DC resistance for high-frequency bonding.
example_1_zh: 對高頻接合而言，RF 阻抗比直流電阻更重要。
example_2_en: The reference ring should minimize RF impedance.
example_2_zh: 參考環應盡量降低 RF 阻抗。

example_1_en: A radio-frequency bond is designed for low impedance at high frequency.
example_1_zh: 射頻接合是針對高頻低阻抗所設計。
example_2_en: A radio-frequency bond is important for shields and filters.
example_2_zh: 射頻接合對屏蔽與濾波器很重要。

example_1_en: A low-inductance path is necessary for rapidly changing current.
example_1_zh: 快速變化的電流需要低電感路徑。
example_2_en: A short and wide bond is a low-inductance path at high frequency.
example_2_zh: 短而寬的接合在高頻下是低電感路徑。

example_1_en: Nonconductive coating must be removed from the bonding area.
example_1_zh: 非導電塗層必須從接合區域移除。
example_2_en: A thin nonconductive coating can make a good joint electrically poor.
example_2_zh: 薄薄的非導電塗層可能讓良好的機械接合變成差的電氣接合。

example_1_en: Foreign matter on the contact area can increase resistance.
example_1_zh: 接觸區域上的異物會增加電阻。
example_2_en: Remove all chips, dust, and foreign matter before assembly.
example_2_zh: 組裝前應移除所有切屑、灰塵與異物。

example_1_en: A micro-ohmmeter is used to measure very low bonding resistance.
example_1_zh: 微歐姆計用於量測很低的接合電阻。
example_2_en: Use a four-wire method with the micro-ohmmeter.
example_2_zh: 使用微歐姆計時應採用四線式量測。

example_1_en: Historically, Class R bonding has been associated with 2.5 milliohms.
example_1_zh: 歷史上，R 類搭接 通常與 2.5 mΩ 相關。
example_2_en: Historically, DC resistance was used as a workmanship indicator.
example_2_zh: 過去以來，DC 電阻常被用作品質指標。

example_1_en: Class R bonding is associated with RF suppression performance.
example_1_zh: R 類搭接 與 RF 抑制性能相關。
example_2_en: The risk is associated with high current and fast rise time.
example_2_zh: 此風險與高電流及快速上升時間相關。

example_1_en: Unfortunately, low DC resistance does not guarantee low RF impedance.
example_1_zh: 可惜的是，低 DC 電阻不保證低 RF 阻抗。
example_2_en: Unfortunately, long straps can behave poorly at high frequency.
example_2_zh: 可惜的是，長 搭接帶 在高頻下表現可能很差。

example_1_en: Measuring DC resistance is relatively easy with a micro-ohmmeter.
example_1_zh: 使用 微歐姆計 量測 DC 電阻相對容易。
example_2_en: Bond inspection is relatively easy with clear drawing notes.
example_2_zh: 有清楚圖面註記時，搭接 檢查相對容易。

example_1_en: A direct RF bond may not be realistically obtained with shock mounts.
example_1_zh: 使用 隔振座 時，直接 RF 搭接 可能實際上無法達成。
example_2_en: Choose a method that can be realistically manufactured and inspected.
example_2_zh: 選擇能實際製造與檢查的方法。

example_1_en: Lightning strikes can induce large currents in the structure.
example_1_zh: 雷擊可能在結構中感應大電流。
example_2_en: A strike path should stay outside the vehicle.
example_2_zh: 雷擊路徑應盡量保持在載具外部。

example_1_en: Lightning current may enter one extremity of the vehicle.
example_1_zh: 雷擊電流可能從載具一端進入。
example_2_en: Bonding should provide a current path from one extremity to another.
example_2_zh: 搭接 應提供從一端到另一端的電流路徑。

example_1_en: The handbook uses "lightning current" when it explains the purpose or performance of an electrical bond.
example_1_zh: 「雷擊電流」會影響電氣接合的目的或性能。
example_2_en: The designer reviews "lightning current" before selecting a bonding class.
example_2_zh: 設計人員會在選擇接合等級前評估「雷擊電流」。

example_1_en: The design should keep enough electrical and thermal margin.
example_1_zh: 設計應保留足夠的電氣與熱裕度。
example_2_en: A poor bonding path can reduce EMC margin.
example_2_zh: 不良接合路徑可能降低 EMC 裕度。

example_1_en: Do not use soldered terminals for lightning current paths.
example_1_zh: 雷擊電流路徑不要使用焊接端子。
example_2_en: Soldered terminals may fail under high-current transients.
example_2_zh: 焊接端子可能在高電流暫態下失效。

example_1_en: Fuel and pyrotechnics should be enclosed by a Faraday cage to provide an adequate margin against ignition.
example_1_zh: 燃料與火工品應由 法拉第籠 包覆，以提供足夠的防點燃裕度。
example_2_en: A bond must carry lightning current without heating enough to become an ignition hazard.
example_2_zh: 搭接 必須能承載雷擊電流，且不得因過熱而形成點燃危害。

example_1_en: Bonding near areas around fuel requires special attention.
example_1_zh: 燃料周圍區域的 搭接 需要特別注意。
example_2_en: Avoid sparks around fuel during fault or lightning conditions.
example_2_zh: 在故障或雷擊條件下，應避免燃料周圍產生火花。

example_1_en: Joints near flammable liquids are considered hazardous.
example_1_zh: 靠近易燃液體的接合處被視為危險。
example_2_en: Bonding near flammable liquids must be reviewed carefully.
example_2_zh: 易燃液體附近的 搭接 必須仔細審查。

example_1_en: Sparking between panels may cause perforation of the vehicle skin.
example_1_zh: 面板間火花可能造成載具外殼穿孔。
example_2_en: Inspect the panel for perforation after a high-current event.
example_2_zh: 高電流事件後應檢查面板是否穿孔。

example_1_en: A lightning bond is designed to carry large transient currents.
example_1_zh: 雷擊電流接合是為承載大型暫態電流而設計。
example_2_en: A lightning bond is kept short to reduce series inductance.
example_2_zh: 雷擊電流接合會保持短路徑以降低串聯電感。

example_1_en: Most crimped connectors are satisfactory for bonding jumpers.
example_1_zh: 大多數壓接式接頭可用於 搭接跨接線。
example_2_en: Use a qualified crimped terminal for the strap.
example_2_zh: 搭接帶 應使用合格的壓接端子。

chinese_meaning: 火工品；爆炸螺栓等火工裝置
example_1_en: Pyrotechnics require special attention to prevent accidental ignition.
example_1_zh: 火工品需要特別注意，以避免意外點燃。
example_2_en: Wires to pyrotechnics should be carefully shielded and terminated.
example_2_zh: 連到火工品的線路應仔細屏蔽並妥善終端處理。

example_1_en: Most crimped connectors are satisfactory for this application.
example_1_zh: 大多數壓接式接頭對此應用是可接受的。
example_2_en: A low resistance reading is a satisfactory workmanship indicator.
example_2_zh: 低電阻讀值是可接受的作業品質指標。

example_1_en: The design must provide an adequate margin against ignition.
example_1_zh: 設計必須提供足夠的防點燃裕度。
example_2_en: The contact area must be adequate for the expected current.
example_2_zh: 接觸面積必須足以承載預期電流。

example_1_en: This is particularly important around fuel and pyrotechnics.
example_1_zh: 這在燃料與火工品周圍特別重要。
example_2_en: Class R bonding is particularly sensitive to strap length.
example_2_zh: R 類搭接對 搭接帶 長度特別敏感。

example_1_en: The Faraday cage provides protection against ignition.
example_1_zh: 法拉第籠 提供防止點燃的保護。
example_2_en: The bonding path should protect against arcing at joints.
example_2_zh: 搭接路徑 應防止接合點電弧。

chinese_meaning: 孔洞；開口；電磁洩漏開口
example_1_en: An unbonded seam can become an RF aperture.

example_2_en: Reducing aperture size improves enclosure performance.
example_2_zh: 縮小開口尺寸可改善外殼性能。

example_2_en: Sparks must not jump between metallic structures near fuel.
example_2_zh: 火花不得在燃料附近的金屬結構間跳躍。
